profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer @ Palo Alto Networks

company.name: Expanse, A Palo Alto Networks Company

positions.title: Cyber Risk Data Analyst III
positions.description:
- Identified critical exposures (Telnet, RDP, FTP servers, etc) that aided in customer threat mitigation for Fortune 500 companies.
- Analyzed data to determine the most complete customer profile of public assets.
- Trained, onboarded, and created processes that helped scale our team from 4 to 20 team members.

positions.title: Cyber Risk Scripting Lead
positions.description:
- Developed Python scripts for internal teams to assist with data aggregation/analysis of customer data.
- Maintained, monitored, and aided in development of 30+ Python user facing scripts.
- Led backlog grooming sessions, github releases, peer coding sessions, QA of github PRs, and more.
- Worked along-side internal engineering teams to utilize internal API endpoints in our scripts.

positions.title: Experienced Associate- Cybersecurity Risk and Compliance Consultant
positions.description:
- Advised clients on cybersecurity best practices for building strategies in risk mitigation, incident reporting, intrusion detection monitoring, change management (SDLC), access control, penetration tests, and vulnerability scanning to aid in compliance with SOC1, SOC2, NIST, GDPR, and HITRUST, and various cybersecurity standards.
- Exposed to various client cloud production/infrastructure environments (AWS, Google Cloud, Heroku) and gained an understanding of different DevOps processes.
- Communicated directly with CTO’s, Chief Information Security Officers, network architects, and senior engineers to discuss methods on security improvements. 
- Trained new hires on technical analysis, cybersecurity practices, client communication skills, data analysis, and internal processes.
